bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
src="eed6a9add3c1071969fd7ee98c0adf12472aeb81"
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-confirm-eed6a9a-20261119"
test -d "$root" || exit 60
test "$(git -C "$root" remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#^git@github.com:#https://github.com/#')" = "https://github.com/seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot.git" || exit 61
mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
if [ -e "$stage" ]; then
 test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 62
else
 git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin "$src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
 test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 64
 git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$stage" "$src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
fi
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain)" || exit 66
test -f "$stage/artifacts/bot/src/bot/bugReportHandlers.ts" || exit 67
test -f "$stage/artifacts/bot/tests/bugReportHandlers.test.ts" || exit 68
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 69
docker build --network host --pull=false -f "$stage/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-confirm-eed6a9a "$stage" >/tmp/gace-bug-confirm-build.log 2>&1 || exit 70
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-confirm-eed6a9a --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 71
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 72
echo BUG_REPORT_CONFIRM_IMAGE_STAGE=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_OWNER_PRESERVED=PASS
